summary: Full test of Bookkeeping feature (P&L ledger + recurring). Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed covering meta, list, CRUD, validation (bad category / bad date / amount 0), VA 403 auth-gate, summary shape, CSV export (default + filtered), receipt upload + authorized download via /api/files, recurring auto-generation (creates ledger entry same period when day_of_month<=today, created_by_name 'Recurring (auto)'), pause toggle, delete. Frontend: /ops/bookkeeping loads for admin, nav-bookkeeping present in ops sidebar, 3 tabs render, Overview KPIs + presets + monthly chart + category breakdown + project table all present, Transactions has all filters/table/export/add-entry, Add Entry dialog opens with type toggles + save, seeded entry led_6e24014198e5 shows book-view-receipt link, Recurring tab shows seeded rec_ba13c0546bee ('TEST CRM subscription', Active). Regression: /ops/va-program/digital still loads. No blocking issues.

issues: Uses browser-native <select> for category/type/day-of-month instead of shadcn Select — visually inconsistent with rest of the app (see recurring form 'Software / Subscriptions' dropdown). Cosmetic only, not blocking.
Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description — a11y console warning; add DialogDescription for screen readers.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Replace native <select> with shadcn Select in Recurring form and Transactions filters for visual consistency.
(Optional/a11y) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to book-entry-dialog to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: bookkeeping.py:220-221 — when only `type` changes (no explicit category), _validate_category is called against the existing category, but result isn't written; correct behavior since category stays the same, but if a user flips expense→income without changing the category from 'supplies', the check will 400. This is intended validation and works correctly.
_generate_due_recurring iterates async cursor and writes inside loop — no batching, but volumes are low; acceptable.
recurring_expenses_runner sleeps 6h — fine, and create_recurring also calls _generate_due_recurring synchronously so newly created recurring with day<=today logs immediately as verified.
Receipt upload passes content-type validation and 10MB cap; verified via 1×1 PNG round-trip incl. /api/files/{path} download 200.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke — all data-testids present, dialog opens, seeded entries visible, regression page loads
